title: TRANSITION
author: Priyanka Banerjee
text:
Looking Back in Ecstacy
Humming a soft Tune
Unfolding My Days from
A Toddler to Immaculate Adult

Each Second of Transition
Flashes Back in Desperation
Some Have Been Too Heartening
To Note and Cherish in Elation

Beautiful Mornings Created Vibration
Hot and Humid Days Brought Exasperation
But Like A Sweet Sour Candy Resolution
These All Winged Away with Utmost Contemplation

All that Life Has Taught
Functions As A Lighthouse
To Stay Tune to the New Challenges
And Breaking Barriers to Move

Growing from Pink Green to Grey
Each Colour Has Adorned Me
Inculcating A Powerful Emotion
To Recall All Value Addition

Yes, Swiftly Time Flies
Leaving Behind Its Footprints
So, Embrace Everyrhing in Adoration
For It`s A Welcoming Transition
